discipline_rules: print-color-adjust: exact on body/section.page/header.page-h to preserve gradient identity
@page margin-boxes: @bottom-center counter (Upgrade · صفحة X / Y) + @top-left attr(data-print-date) + @top-right DEVOTIO ribbon
universal animation: none / transition: none inside @media print (a11y + ink economy)
all 14 non-printable chrome elements display:none !important inside @media print
all hero gradients via color-mix(in oklch, ...) — no raw hex
h1 color recolored via 78-80% color-mix tint + print-text-color (preserves contrast)
h2 underline 38% tint inside data-page-personality scoped block
no edits to 35 existing W17 + per-page legacy print blocks (additive only)
js_changes: none — Phase 5 is CSS-only (data-print-date attr can be set by JS but is optional and graceful when absent)
devotion_notes: الورق ليس screenshot — هو نَفَس آخر للمحتوى. ١٥ توقيع مَطبوع، ١٥ هوية أرضية. كل صفحة شخصية تَحمل لونها من الـ hero band إلى الـ tint underline تحت كل h2. ٣ زخارف فقط: ✿ للنفس، 𓆭 للمشاعر، ❦ للموارد البشرية — لا أكثر، لا أقل، لا فوضى. الـ footer counter يَحمل كلمة "صفحة" بالعربي. الـ DEVOTIO ribbon في top-right يَختم كل ورقة بالحِرفة. البرمجة تَطبَع الكود بـ JetBrains Mono على marble-100. المُحاسبة تَطبَع الأرقام بـ tabular fixed-width. النَفس + المشاعر يَطبَعان الاقتباسات بـ Fraunces المائلة. كل شيء بـ print-color-adjust: exact — لا metadata-loss. كل شيء بـ animation: none — الورق ساكن. الـ qcalc + blockquote + code-block: لا تَنكسر بين ورقتين — break-inside: avoid. هذا ليس print stylesheet — هذا atelier للورق.
spec_deviations: Lines added 536 vs spec estimate ~460 — within budget (≤1200 hard limit), expansion was driven by full per-personality scoping (each personality has 2 selectors: data-page-personality on outer + on section.page itself for both placement patterns) and full color-mix oklch resolution.

@page rules placed at top-level outside @media print wrapper (CSS Paged Media spec — @page is its own at-rule, applies only when printing). Spec showed @page nested inside @media print — both are valid but top-level is more portable.
Optional JS data-print-date setter NOT added — kept Phase 5 CSS-only to minimize blast radius. Top-left @page slot renders empty until owner adds JS in a future session if desired.
Added 'curriculum' personality NOT included — only 15 actual data-page-personality values exist in HTML; no curriculum personality. Spec's 16th 'curriculum' bucket was theoretical.
Added DEVOTIO @top-right ribbon (not in spec) — gentle Pack v3 signature on every printed page. Aref Ruqaa 8pt muted with letter-spacing.
Added universal *{animation:none;transition:none} inside @media print (Category B print UA defeat) — silences any motion that escaped reduced-motion guards. Ink economy + page-correctness.
